reading.body:
Five projects make up this collection with a combined 287,786 GitHub stars, led by browser-use at 111,977 stars, more than the combined stars of the next two projects, cline at 67,304 and aider at 48,656.

The five split cleanly by purpose: browser-use and stagehand, at 24,124 stars, both automate web browsers for agents, while cline, aider, and continue, at 35,725 stars, are coding agents built as an IDE extension, a terminal pair-programming tool, and an open-source coding agent respectively. That two of the five tools target browser automation specifically, rather than code generation, shows this category covers a broader scope than its coding-only projects would suggest on their own.

Licensing splits 3 to 2 toward Apache-2.0 over MIT, cline, aider, and continue under Apache-2.0 and browser-use and stagehand under MIT, a pattern that roughly matches the broader ai-frameworks category elsewhere in this collection, where Apache-2.0 is also the single most common licence among several options.
